text:
Evan K.: Heads up — saw a weird dip in weekly conversions on the Launch Performance dashboard this morning. Spike in impressions but conversions lag. Posting here to avoid siloed slack threads. Dash link: https://dash.redwood.ai/launch/performance
Nora M.: which widget? total conv or source breakdown?
Evan K.: total conv rate widget. Week over week went from 4.6% -> 3.1%. Impressions +12%, clicks flat.
Diego Ruiz: did we change the launch post copy or CTA Monday? I pushed a variant to socials on Mon 07:30 but that shouldn't tank conversions.
Samir (growth): we did toggle the short-form CTAs in 3 posts to the new /signup-lite URL. That had a slightly different tracking suffix.
Hannah (analytics): ops-bot, can you run a freshness check on events and surface any ingestion backfills in the last 72h?
ops-bot: running: event freshness check id efc-22. Scanning ingestion logs...
ops-bot: result: no backfills. Two ingestion warnings (2024-11-06 03:14 UTC) related to clickstream parsing failures — ~0.4% of events dropped and auto-retried, resolved.
Nora M.: 0.4% shouldn't explain a ~33% conv drop. Could be attribution model shift (we rolled last-touch priority for partners to top last week).
Hannah (analytics): good catch. I pulled last-touch vs first-touch for webinar launch funnel: last-touch conv 3.2% vs first-touch 4.7% prior period. Partners attribution moved to last-touch — that will lower multi-touch counts.
Evan K.: okay — so two signals: 1) routing to /signup-lite with different utm mapping, 2) attribution policy change. Which is dominant?
Diego Ruiz: quick check — the /signup-lite link drops utm_medium and only keeps utm_campaign. GA capture mapping expects medium for channel rules.
Hannah (analytics): run: cohort (7d) where landing = /signup-lite -> conv rate 2.1%. For canonical landing conv 4.3%. But sample for /signup-lite is smallish (n=540).
Samir (growth): are we double-counting ad conversions in weekly numbers? I saw a join on click_id that was updated to dedupe by ga_session last deploy.
Hannah (analytics): there was a dedupe tweak in ETL on 11/05: we started collapsing events by click_id+user_id. That lowered duplicate conversion rows by ~8% historically. Could shave numbers.
Nora M.: timeline recap: Mon morning short-CTA rollout -> Mon 07:30 posts -> ETL dedupe change deployed Mon 09:00 -> Attribution policy flip Tue 02:00. All within 48h. No wonder dashboard moves.
Evan K.: action plan proposal:
- Reconcile dashboard with raw conversion table for the last 14 days and produce a delta table (Hannah)
- Map /signup-lite utm mapping to include utm_medium in GA ingest (Diego + eng) or update the link (Diego)
- Revisit attribution policy for weekly KPI board to use multi-touch rollup for trend reporting (Nora + Samir)
- Add a short note in the weekly KPI deck about the dedupe change (Evan)
Can folks ack with ETAs?
Hannah (analytics): ack — reconciliation query running, will drop CSV in docs in 45m. ETA summary in 1h.
Diego Ruiz: ack — will patch the /signup-lite to carry utm_medium by EOD and coordinate with eng. If devs busy, will rollback to canonical link.
Samir (growth): ack — will draft note for KPI deck and run comparative charts of last-touch vs multi-touch for the weekly review. ETA by tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Nora M.: ack — happy to roll back attribution on KPI board to multi-touch for trend lines; will update dashboard description and notify execs.
Evan K.: thanks. One more ask: can we surface a small “annotation” on the dashboard for Nov 5-7 so future readers know these config changes occurred?
Hannah (analytics): yep I can add an annotation and pin the reconciliation CSV.
Diego Ruiz: quick test: added utm_medium to a test /signup-lite click in staging — tracking captured successfully. Will push to prod after a smoke test at 17:30.
ops-bot: smoke test scheduled at 17:30 UTC. Notification will post on completion.
Evan K.: great. If the reconciliation shows dedupe/attribution explains most of the drop, we'll treat this as a reporting artifact. If not, we'll pivot to messaging and landing experience work. Will report back in tomorrow's KPI sync. :thumbsup:
